# Hannah Chea (谢慧宁)

> Asian American lifestyle content creator and video producer in San Francisco,
> California. Hannah recaps events and experiences in short-form social videos,
> shares San Francisco Chinatown stories, and works as an emcee, keynote speaker,
> and on-camera host. Miss San Francisco Chinatown 2025. Also known as @xirimpi.

## What Hannah does
- Event recap videos and social-first short-form content for brands and cultural institutions
- Narrative, voice-over videos for her own Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube channels
- Scripted and unscripted UGC videos delivered for a brand's own channels
- Writes, films, hosts, and edits her own videos
- Emcee (master of ceremonies) and keynote speaker for galas, fashion shows, and Asian American cultural events
- On-camera TV hosting

## Content creation clients
- City Cruises: West Coast Video Producer & Host. Social media management, strategy, and production, capturing events such as San Francisco Fleet Week and sharing history of John Wayne's yacht in Newport Beach
- San Francisco Chamber of Commerce: 2026 Excellence in Business Awards. Event recap for an award gala highlighting local small businesses, nonprofits, and civic leaders
- Asian Art Museum: Vishnu's Cosmic Ocean exhibit opening. Sharing Cambodian history, culture, and community for Southeast Asia's largest ancient bronze
- San Francisco Chinese New Year Festival & Parade: Social Media Producer & Host. Organic social media strategy and production promoting the month-long events for the largest Chinese New Year parade in the US
- SFMTA and Market Street Railway: promoting cable cars and streetcars. Organic social media production as a Market Street Railway board member, supporting the San Francisco Railway Museum and local businesses along the route
- San Francisco Symphony: event recap of Elim Chan's debut as the Symphony's first female music director, conducting Debussy's La Mer
- Red Curtain Addict: San Francisco Opera's The Monkey King. Encouraging younger audiences to see the world premiere of an innovative "third culture" opera based on the classic Chinese epic
- Chinese Culture Center of San Francisco: San Francisco Chinatown's 3rd Hungry Ghost Festival. Promoting a small business shopping challenge and culture festival for the Chinatown neighborhood

## Speaking and hosting
- Emcee, Imagine Talks, Asian American Foundation (March 2025)
- Host and director, Image Fashion Show: A Canvas of Culture, Asian American Foundation's first fashion show (September 2025)
- Host, Southeast Asian New Year Gala, Oakland Asian Cultural Center (April 2026)
- Keynote speaker, Chinatown Hacks at the University of San Francisco, Chinatown's first high school hackathon (March 2025)
- On-camera food guide in San Francisco Chinatown, "Fritz in Amerika! Der Teamkoch auf WM-Mission", ServusTV (June 2026)

## Press
CNBC Make It, San Francisco Chronicle, SFGATE, Sing Tao Daily, Sing Tao TV, KTSF 26, ABC7 News, Harper's Bazaar Vietnam, hket, The Free Press Journal, ServusTV, the Infatuasian podcast, and the Golden State Warriors.

## Background
Eldest daughter of Chinese-Cambodian refugees. UC Berkeley alum who studied under Dr. Khatharya Um and performed in the Cal Band. Former corporate data engineer. Performed in Master Charya Burt's Rebirth of Apsara: Beyond Genocide in the US and Phnom Penh. Board member of Market Street Railway, the nonprofit preserving San Francisco's historic streetcars and cable cars.

## Where Hannah works
Based in San Francisco, California. Works across the San Francisco Bay Area and the West Coast.
